site.name: AirgapPDF
site.tagline: PDF tools that never touch the internet.
site.description: Free PDF tools that run entirely in your browser. Merge, split, sign, edit and redact PDFs without uploading them anywhere. Works offline.

pages.name: Merge PDF
pages.short: Combine several PDFs into one file, in any order.
pages.title: Merge PDF Files Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Merge PDF files without uploading them
pages.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one, right in your browser. Your files never leave your device and the tool works offline.
steps: Add two or more PDF files.
Drag files or individual pages into the order you want.
Press Merge and save the combined PDF.
faq: Are my files uploaded to a server?
No. AirgapPDF merges files with code running in your browser. You can disconnect from the internet before adding files and it still works.
Is there a limit on the number of files?
No fixed limit. Very large files are limited only by your device's memory.

pages.name: Split PDF
pages.short: Split a PDF by page ranges or into equal parts.
pages.title: Split PDF Offline - Extract Page Ranges Privately | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Split a PDF without uploading it
pages.description: Split a PDF into separate files by page ranges or every N pages. Processing happens on your device, never on a server.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Choose page ranges, a fixed number of pages per file, or pick pages.
Press Split and save the files (several files come as a ZIP).
faq: How do I write page ranges?
Use commas and dashes, for example 1-3, 5, 8-10. Each range becomes its own PDF.
Does splitting reduce quality?
No. Pages are copied as-is, nothing is re-compressed.

pages.name: Organize pages
pages.short: Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate or insert blank pages.
pages.title: Organize PDF Pages Offline - Reorder, Rotate, Delete | AirgapPDF
pages.description: Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate and insert blank pages in a PDF. Everything runs locally in your browser.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Drag pages to reorder them, and use each page's buttons to rotate, duplicate or delete.
Press Save to download the reorganized PDF.
faq: Can I undo a change?
Yes, use Undo or press Ctrl+Z. Your original file is never modified.

pages.name: Rotate PDF
pages.short: Rotate some or all pages and save.
pages.title: Rotate PDF Pages Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.description: Rotate individual pages or the whole PDF by 90 or 180 degrees. Runs in your browser, works offline.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Rotate single pages, or use Rotate all.
Press Save to download the rotated PDF.
faq: Is the rotation permanent?
Yes, the saved PDF opens rotated in every viewer.

pages.name: Delete pages
pages.short: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF.
pages.title: Delete Pages from PDF Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Delete pages from a PDF privately
pages.description: Remove pages from a PDF directly in your browser. Your document stays on your device.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Click the pages you want to remove.
Press Save to download the PDF without them.
faq: Is the deleted content really gone?
Yes. Removed pages are not copied into the new file.

pages.name: Extract pages
pages.short: Pick pages and save them as a new PDF.
pages.title: Extract Pages from PDF Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Extract pages from a PDF privately
pages.description: Select pages from a PDF and save them as a new document, all in your browser.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Click the pages you want to keep.
Press Extract to download a PDF with only those pages.
faq: Is my original changed?
No. Extraction creates a new file and leaves the original untouched.

pages.name: Images to PDF
pages.short: Turn JPG, PNG or WebP images into a PDF.
pages.title: JPG and PNG to PDF Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Convert images to PDF without uploading
pages.description: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images into a single PDF with your choice of page size and margins. Runs locally.
steps: Add one or more images.
Drag to reorder and choose page size, orientation and margins.
Press Create PDF and save it.
faq: Are images compressed?
JPG and PNG images are embedded as-is. WebP and other formats are converted to PNG first.

pages.name: PDF to images
pages.short: Save PDF pages as PNG or JPG images.
pages.title: PDF to JPG or PNG Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Convert PDF pages to images privately
pages.description: Export PDF pages as PNG or JPG images at the resolution you choose. Rendering happens on your device.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Choose the format, resolution and pages.
Press Convert and save the images (several images come as a ZIP).
faq: Which resolution should I pick?
150 DPI is good for screens, 300 DPI for printing.

pages.name: Sign PDF
pages.short: Draw, type or upload a signature and place it.
pages.title: Sign PDF Offline - Private E-Signature, No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Sign a PDF without uploading it
pages.description: Draw, type or upload your signature and place it on any page. Your document and signature never leave your device.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Create your signature by drawing, typing or uploading an image.
Place and resize it on the page, then save the signed PDF.
faq: Is my signature stored?
Only if you tick Remember on this device, and then only in this browser. It is never sent anywhere.
Is this a legally binding signature?
It adds a visual signature, which is accepted for many everyday documents. It is not a certificate-based digital signature.

pages.name: Add text
pages.short: Type on a PDF, add checkmarks, dates or white-out.
pages.title: Add Text to PDF Offline - Free PDF Editor, No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Add text to a PDF privately
pages.description: Type anywhere on a PDF, add checkmarks and dates, or white out content. Editing happens entirely in your browser.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Pick Text, Checkmark, Date or White-out and click on the page.
Adjust, then save the edited PDF.
faq: Does white-out remove the text underneath?
No, it covers it visually. To remove content for real, use the Redact tool.

pages.name: Watermark
pages.short: Stamp text or an image across pages.
pages.title: Watermark PDF Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Add a watermark to a PDF privately
pages.description: Add a text or image watermark with custom opacity, angle and position. Runs on your device.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Type the watermark text or choose an image, then adjust the style.
Press Apply and save the watermarked PDF.
faq: Can I watermark only some pages?
Yes, enter a page range such as 1-3, 7.

pages.name: Page numbers
pages.short: Number pages with your choice of style and position.
pages.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Add page numbers to a PDF privately
pages.description: Number the pages of a PDF with your chosen position, format and starting number. Processing stays on your device.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Choose position, format and starting number.
Press Apply and save the numbered PDF.
faq: Can I skip the cover page?
Yes. Set the page range to start from page 2 and choose the starting number you want.

pages.name: Fill forms
pages.short: Fill in PDF form fields and optionally lock them.
pages.title: Fill PDF Forms Offline - No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.description: Fill text fields, checkboxes and dropdowns in PDF forms, then save or flatten. Your answers never leave your device.
steps: Add a PDF form.
Fill in the fields shown in the side panel.
Save, optionally flattening so the answers can no longer be edited.
faq: My PDF shows no fields. Why?
The form may be a scanned image or use the XFA format. Use Add text to type on it instead.

pages.name: Redact
pages.title: Redact PDF Offline - True Redaction, No Upload | AirgapPDF
pages.h1: Redact a PDF permanently, without uploading it
pages.description: Black out sensitive text and images for real. Redacted pages are flattened so hidden content cannot be copied back out.
steps: Add a PDF file.
Draw boxes over everything you want to hide.
Press Redact and save. Redacted pages are flattened to images.
faq: Why can't I select text on redacted pages afterwards?
To guarantee hidden text is gone, redacted pages are converted to images. Pages without redactions keep their selectable text.
Is a black box enough?
Many tools only draw a box over text that can still be copied. AirgapPDF removes the content underneath.

extra.title: How We Prove Your Files Never Leave Your Device | AirgapPDF
extra.description: Three ways to verify that AirgapPDF never uploads your files: the airplane-mode test, the network inspector, and the security policy enforced by your browser.
